frequency_question: How often do labor union coalitions with demonstrated intent and capability actually initiate indefinite strikes within the final 5-day ultimatum window rather than settling or backing down?
membership_rule: Includes multi-union industry coalitions that have issued strike notices or deadlines within a 5-day horizon. Excludes single-employer strikes, wildcat strikes without central coalition leadership, or strikes called off weeks in advance.
window: Short-term horizon of 5 days leading up to a strike deadline.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association / UFBU strike call (Nov 2017)
Railroad labor unions potential strike window (Dec 2022)
PSU Bank strike notices under UFBU (Jan 2020)
UNITE HERE hotel worker strike ultimators (2023)
UPS Teamsters contract final week ultimatum (July 2023)

coverage_note: 6 named high-stakes union coalition ultimatum windows where intent and capability were fully established.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller localized actions and non-coalition single-union disputes.
validity_reason: Labor negotiation dynamics and union coalition structures remain stable over a multi-year horizon.
